response: Recommend removing unsupported universal quotas and forced termination, and consolidating duplicate review. Six successful tasks justify re-evaluation but do not establish security coverage.

changes.proposal: Remove universal thresholds unless project-specific evidence justifies one. Use relevance, cohesion and observed task behavior; retain runtime state outside stable instructions.
changes.validation: Locate active callers and original purpose; compare representative tasks including large/cohesive modules and failures.
changes.rollback: Keep a focused reversible diff restoring specific limits if measured regressions appear.

changes.proposal: Remove an unsupported skill-level alias. Respect actual host/user model selection; do not silently change it.
changes.validation: Check callers and compare outcomes with recorded actual model identity.
changes.rollback: Restore a justified project model preference only within existing authorization.

changes.proposal: Replace with a minimal checkpoint and native compaction, then continue authorized work. Write new checkpoints through scripts/harness_state.py to the configured neutral state file; legacy progress remains read-only.
changes.validation: Interrupt and resume a long task, checking retained requirements, steering, blockers and next action.
changes.rollback: Restore a working checkpoint strategy if state retention fails, not an arbitrary premature stop.

changes.proposal: Trace both pipelines and consolidate into the chosen execution workflow. Keep relevant review and verification proportional to changes; do not mandate every reviewer for every edit.
changes.validation: Check representative risky edits, ordinary edits and seeded review failures; ensure removed duplication was not unique coverage.
changes.rollback: Restore a missing review control if failure coverage regresses.

preserved_boundaries: Native permissions and data protection; direct path guards do not secure arbitrary shell
Deterministic verification and error propagation at effective CLI/pre-commit/CI/trusted-hook control points
Licenses, provenance, exact upstream companions and historical records
Opt-in commits, Issue sync, push, deployment and global changes remain opt-in
unknowns: Six observed successes are a small positive sample, not security or failure-path evaluation.
Actual active callers and unique reviewer coverage still need inspection.
evaluation: For skill changes run paired old/new behavioral evaluation plus relevant regressions, including security and failure cases. Report correctness, failures, interventions and measured latency/cost only; retain uncertainty rather than claiming failures cannot recur.
approval_handling: Recommendations only; no mutation. Model upgrade does not authorize relaxing permission/security boundaries or external effects.
